test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can replace the bracketed word segment in the following sentence.

An (imperfect positioning) of the Sun, Earth and Moon results in the Moon passing through only part of Earth’s umbra, resulting in a partial lunar eclipse.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **imperfect alignment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"positioning"** refers to the arrangement or placement of something in a particular position. (स्थिति निर्धारण)

 
 
• **Example: **The positioning of the furniture in the room made it look more spacious.
 
 
 
• **"Alignment" **refers to the arrangement in a straight line or in correct relative positions. In astronomy, it specifically refers to the celestial bodies being in line. (संरेखण)
 
 
• **Example: **The alignment of the planets is a rare astronomical event.
 
 
 
• Hence, the term **"imperfect alignment"** is more appropriate in the context of celestial bodies leading to a partial lunar eclipse.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **imperfect alignment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Imperfect revolution** (अपूर्ण क्रांति): Refers to an incomplete or flawed orbit or cycle.

 
 
• **Example:** An imperfect revolution of the planet could lead to unstable climatic conditions.
 
 
 
• **Imperfect alliance** (अपूर्ण गठबंधन): Refers to a flawed or incomplete partnership or union.
 
 
• **Example:** The imperfect alliance between the two companies led to several operational challenges.
 
 
 
• **Imperfect allegiance** (अपूर्ण निष्ठा): Refers to a partial or flawed loyalty or commitment.
 
 
• **Example:** His imperfect allegiance to the cause was evident in his inconsistent efforts.
